author: reek
body: The tamper and short-record cases matter more than the happy path. A record layer that is merely self-consistent will seal and open its own records perfectly while interoperating with nothing and authenticating nobody.

author: reek
body: The sn_key in the vector above is not a magic constant: it is HKDF-Expand-Label(secret, "sn", "", 16) over secret = 0..31, and the chapter derives it. If this line disagrees with the vector, the label structure is wrong and every mask after it is wrong too.

author: reek
body: And a wrong high part must fail. The nonce binds the FULL 64-bit sequence number, so a receiver that has lost its place cannot be talked into accepting a record at the wrong position in the stream. This is the property, not an accident of the arithmetic.

author: reek
body: One flipped ciphertext byte. The mask is drawn from that same ciphertext, so the sequence number decodes to garbage as well and the AAD is wrong before the tag is even reached -- the record fails twice over, which is the design working.
